_doc: Queue of approved, staged blog posts awaiting their publish date. See scheduled/README.md. Each entry's HTML lives at scheduled/<slug>.html and is moved to blog/<slug>.html on its publishDate by the publish-scheduled GitHub Action. After publish, the post's linkedinTeaser is fired to LinkedIn via the direct poster (scripts/fire-linkedin-direct.mjs).

queue.title: Marketing has no definition of done
queue.description: A founder shipped features on schedule for months and did no marketing at all. He wasn't short of time. He was short of a ticket.
queue.linkedinTeaser: A founder shipped features on schedule for months and did no marketing at all. He wasn't short of time. He was short of a ticket.

queue.title: Your best reader will never use your vocabulary
queue.description: One reader answered six of my posts in two weeks and never once used a word I'd written. He understood all six. That gap is worth more than any survey.
queue.linkedinTeaser: One reader answered six of my posts in two weeks and never once used a word I'd written. He understood all six. That gap is worth more than any survey.
